correctness_conclusion: The minimal candidate-policy diff implements the fixed frozen-C1 controls: original Hann winner in slot0; all256 ranking by Hann or raw only after removing the local-peak filter; at most five slots; unchanged spacing>=2/NMS<0.7; unchanged C1 features and selection score; no extra visual forward. Default peaks and pause0 preserve previous numerical behavior in CPU fixtures and the tracking-function AST is unchanged. The full98 collector correctly measures both causal trajectory harms/rescues and per-state candidate/write localization proxies against actual GT.

test_harness_correction.reason: The first harness imposed an unjustified 1e-4 IoU tolerance between full-precision timeline boxes and 3-decimal saved predictions. Corrected only the test to the production selected-coordinate tolerance of 0.000501; production source was not changed.

limitations: This source/CPU review is not genuine GPU M0 or efficacy evidence. Full98 execution still depends on the separate real1935-frame default-parity/dense M0 and the fixed launch config.
Synthetic dense collector artifacts are review fixtures only. They must not be reported as candidate-policy inference or latency results.
The new policy changes subsequent causal state. Paired trajectory effects are distinct from same-state candidate reselection counters.
Candidate correctness, harms and template contamination are localization proxies, not semantic identity labels.
5000 paired sequence bootstrap intervals condition on fixed weights and are not training-seed uncertainty.
Completion requires candidate_policy_completed.txt plus the JSON and 294-row CSV; an injected CSV failure correctly leaves no marker even if JSON exists.
